name: Tipalti
summary: Tipalti is an AP platform built for companies that pay suppliers abroad. Its pricing page shows Accounts Payable plans starting at $99 a month with unlimited users, then adds per-invoice and per-payment fees by quote. It lists payments in 200+ countries and territories and ERP connections including NetSuite, Sage Intacct and SAP.

facts.text: Tipalti says its Invoice Capture Agent extracts invoice data at header and line-item level, including foreign-currency amounts and VAT.
Tipalti says approval rules can be set at header or line-item level, and approvers can sign off from email without logging in.
Tipalti advertises payments in 200+ countries and territories, 120 local currencies and 50+ payment methods.
Tipalti's data processing addendum says it undergoes a SOC 2 Type II audit every year.
Pricing FAQ: pricing is a subscription plus transaction-based fees, depending on payment volume, number of entities and enabled modules.

plans.name: Accounts Payable
plans.notes: Starting price with unlimited users; the page does not label the currency. Transaction fees per invoice and payment are extra, and a custom quote is required

plans.name: Mass Payments
plans.notes: Starting price with unlimited users and a payee portal. Transaction fees per payment are extra

hiddenCosts: Per-invoice and per-payment transaction fees are charged on top of the subscription, and the amounts are not published.
Procurement, Expenses and Treasury are separate modules, and complex setups may need paid professional services.
